assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
The diagnosis is sick sinus syndrome coded as I49.5.
Continuous ambulatory monitoring via CPT 93226 is indicated.
CPT 93226 represents a 48-hour Holter monitoring study.

The 48-hour Holter monitoring study is medically necessary to detect intermittent arrhythmias associated with sick sinus syndrome and to identify arrhythmic contributors to the patient's palpitations and lightheadedness.
